messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Pardiso
parts:
You can remove this line. Its only if you want to use the PARDISO
library (which is there already but needs to be enabled). Unfortunately,
the license-practicals has changed and its currently not possible to get
a new license as INLA is compiled with the old version of the library.
Hopefully this will be fixed, in the near future.

Best
H
